entities.name: Chishiro
entities.description: A four-armed, scaled orochi swordsman hired as a sellsword to defend Far Corner, once bonded to the kami Kaima as a member of a Jukai order.

entities.name: Kaima
aliases: the kami of Far Corner's shrine
entities.description: A boar-headed kami once bonded to Chishiro, whose bond was broken by Tatsunari; he now sleeps in a shrine in Far Corner and awakens in rage.

entities.name: Ayari
entities.description: A young scarred woman of Far Corner skilled with knives, who acts as Chishiro's right hand.

entities.name: Jenzo
entities.description: A young mechanic of Far Corner whose hand the Mukotai nailed to the gate and who builds disruptors with a prosthetic.

entities.name: Tatsunari
entities.description: A human Mukotai leader riding a corpse-swallower toad who, as a boy, poisoned Chishiro's order and tried to force a bond with Kaima.

entities.name: Chishiro's Futurist captive
entities.description: A moonfolk Futurist whom Chishiro let go into Jukai; this page does not name her.

entities.name: Mukotai
entities.description: A Reckoner gang that prizes clever thieves and attacks Far Corner after their scout's death.

entities.name: Reckoners
entities.description: Criminal gangs of Towashi demanding tithes.

entities.name: Jukai order
entities.description: The order of Jukai kami-bonded warriors to which Chishiro once belonged, wiped out by Tatsunari.

entities.name: Futurists
entities.description: Technologists who encroach on Jukai and whom Chishiro's order hunted.

entities.name: Far Corner
entities.description: A neglected neighborhood on the edge of Towashi and Jukai, centered on a shrine growing from a black root.

entities.name: Far Corner shrine
entities.description: A small natural shrine formed in a knot of black root in which Kaima sleeps.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: The city that has absorbed Far Corner.

entities.name: Jukai Forest
entities.description: The receding forest beside Far Corner, home to kami.

entities.name: Disruptor
entities.description: A device that tears magic from metal, built by Jukai-sworn crafters and used in the trap against the Mukotai.

entities.name: Kaima's focus
entities.description: The jade-edged blade that is the crystallized focus of Chishiro and Kaima's bond; Tatsunari steals it and later it is reforged.

events.summary: Chishiro watches townsfolk worshipping a shrine in Far Corner despite his orders and tells Ayari to send them indoors.
events.quote: "Tell them to get back inside before they make any more mistakes."

events.summary: Chishiro warns the shrine's sleeping kami not to trouble the townsfolk further.
events.quote: "Don't trouble them more than you already have."

events.summary: Chishiro recalls letting a captured Futurist go into Jukai, as he used to do while bonded to Kaima.
events.quote: So, Chishiro let her go, stripped of all her technology and gear, into the depths of the forest she had sought to ravage.

events.summary: The Mukotai threaten Far Corner after their scout was killed by roots, nailing Jenzo's hand to the gate and giving a week's deadline.
events.quote: The Mukotai had signified their intent to retaliate with a hand nailed to the gate of Far Corner.

events.summary: Chishiro trains the townsfolk and plans a trap using disruptors to drive the Mukotai toward Jukai.
events.quote: the plan was to lure the Mukotai down to the Jukai end of Far Corner's main street.

events.summary: The Mukotai arrive on the moonless night of the deadline with a mech and a toad-riding leader.
Chishiro recognizes Tatsunari as the man who betrayed him and leaps from the roof, killing Mukotai fighters.
events.quote: He launched himself from the roof with the vicious totality of his bulk.

events.summary: In a flashback, a boy poisons Chishiro's order at their haven and demands that Kaima bond with him.
events.quote: "Well? You know what I want. Bond with me, and I'll have no need to kill him."

events.summary: In the flashback, Chishiro lets Kaima go, the blade shatters, and Kaima tramples the boy and vanishes with the bond broken.
events.quote: The root in Chishiro's mind snapped, and the blade in the boy's hand shattered.

events.summary: Chishiro burns the bodies of his friends and the villagers and thereafter becomes a sellsword.
events.quote: In the end, he burned the bodies of his friends, and of every villager he could find.

events.summary: The disruptors trigger and the fight turns chaotic, with a Mukotai mech crushing a disruptor.
events.quote: A minuscule squeeze; the disruptor shattered.

events.summary: Chishiro climbs the mech and plants a jade disruptor in the pilot's hands, destroying it.
events.quote: He threw himself from the mech moments before the disruptor sang out

events.summary: Tatsunari reaches the shrine holding Chishiro's old blade and Chishiro realizes Tatsunari hates kami.
Tatsunari stabs Chishiro through the gut, and the shrine's kami awakens, its roots healing Chishiro and attacking the Mukotai.
events.quote: The kami of Far Corner's shrine had awoken, and it said this to Chishiro

events.summary: Chishiro retakes the blade, leaps from the roots and kills Tatsunari's toad, leaving Tatsunari with a broken leg.
Chishiro realizes the awakened kami is Kaima, who intends to destroy everyone, and a Mukotai bruiser rescues Tatsunari.
events.quote: the majesty that had once been Kaima.

events.summary: Chishiro has Ayari and Jenzo evacuate the townsfolk, then confronts Kaima over killing those who love him.
events.quote: Chishiro advanced toward his old friend—blade in hand and root in chest.

events.summary: Chishiro and Kaima realize their rage has poisoned each other and stand down.
Chishiro offers Kaima peace, and Kaima asks him to bond again; Chishiro raises the blade and a light is reborn.

relations.note: once bonded, the bond broken and then renewed
relations.quote: "Then give yourself to me again," said Kaima

relations.note: destroyed Chishiro's order and bond; they fight again
relations.quote: "You," said Tatsunari, as he might to an old friend.
Ayari had designated herself Chishiro's right hand

relations.note: hired by the elders to defend it
relations.quote: The locals had hired him for his grim reputation
the Mukotai intended to burn Far Corner to the ground.
A kami slept within the shrine, the locals told him.
